const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Hina: Starfall Comet (cfg.n = 1) / Starfall (cfg.n = 3) -- approved mockup, Round 3 gold.

// Night-blue dim + starfield, gold hexagram circle with the comet rune ring, then

// gold RO comets (new_comet recoloured by GOLD) on the targets, 420 ms apart.

// Comet i lands on the i-th entry of the target list (cycled), so a repeated

// random target in the list gets two comets, as the mockup allows.

if (!caster || !targets.length) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const ORDER = targets.map((t) => t.id);

for (let i = targets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (targets.findIndex((x) => x.id === targets[i].id) !== i) targets.splice(i, 1);

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t; const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c'); const SC = tl.SCENE, ST = tl.STAGE;

const GOLD = 'hue-rotate(170deg) saturate(1.6) brightness(1.15)';

const fx = (key, at, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const d = A.clips[key]; if (!d) return; m.clip(key, at, { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, w: d.w * 0.85 * (o.scale || 1) * (d.ro ? 1.9 : 1) * U, z: o.z || 50, add: !!o.add, filter: o.filter }); };

const hurt = (at, k) => { m.tint(at, 220, k, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.6 * (1 - u)); const d = -K.dirOf(TOK, k); m.hold(at, at + 300, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (q) q.dx += d * Math.sin(e / 300 * Math.PI * 4) * 9 * U * (1 - e / 300); }); };

// coloured dim (the mockup's night blue): ground layer, under the circle and tokens

const tdim = (at, inMs, to, color, outAt, outMs) => m.hold(at, outAt + outMs, (e, S) => { const tt = at + e; const a = tt < at + inMs ? to * E.sine(e / inMs) : tt < outAt ? to : to * (1 - E.sine((tt - outAt) / outMs)); S.world.push({ z: 0, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.globalAlpha = a; g.fillStyle = color; g.fillRect(SC.x - SC.w, SC.y - SC.h, SC.w * 3, SC.h * 3); g.restore(); } }); });

// starfield: 170 seeded stars over the top two thirds of the stage, under the tokens

const starfield = (at, outAt) => {

const r = tl.rng(4242); const stars = [];

for (let i = 0; i < 170; i++) stars.push({ x: ST.x + r() * ST.w, y: ST.y + r() * ST.h * 0.66, rr: (r() * 1.6 + 0.3) * 4 * U, a: 0.5 + r() * 0.5 });

const spr = document.createElement('canvas'); spr.width = spr.height = 32; const sg = spr.getContext('2d'); const gr = sg.createRadialGradient(16, 16, 0, 16, 16, 16); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(235,240,255,1)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(180,200,255,0)'); sg.fillStyle = gr; sg.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32);

m.hold(at, outAt + 600, (e, S) => { const tt = at + e; const k = tt < at + 600 ? E.sine(e / 600) : tt < outAt ? 1 : 1 - E.sine((tt - outAt) / 600);

S.world.push({ z: 1, draw: (g) => { g.save(); for (const s of stars) { g.globalAlpha = k * s.a; g.drawImage(spr, s.x - s.rr, s.y - s.rr, s.rr * 2, s.rr * 2); } g.restore(); } }); });

};

tdim(0, 600, t.dim, '#060b26', t.end, 600);

starfield(0, t.end);

// cast: step out, Magic3, gold circle + comet ring; step back on release

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.rel, 46);

K.circle(tl, m, U, 'c', 380, t.rel - 380, 48, { dx: dir * 46 * U, ring: 'ringComet', scale: t.scale });

for (let i = 0; i < t.n; i++) {

const id = ORDER[i % ORDER.length]; const k = TG.find((q) => TOK[q].token && TOK[q].token.id === id) || TG[0];

const c0 = t.rel + i * 420; const f0 = K.feet(tl, k);

fx('cometBottom', c0, f0, { scale: 0.7, add: true, z: 2, filter: GOLD });

fx('comet', c0 + 150, f0, { scale: 0.85, add: true, filter: GOLD });

fx('cometSub', c0 + 640, f0, { scale: 0.9, add: true, z: 52, filter: GOLD });

m.shake(c0 + 640, 260, 7 * U); hurt(c0 + 640, k);

}

await tl.run(T, { total: t.end + 650, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Starfall Comet" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Glacies Finis (bespoke). Parametric via a CFG object. Sibling of Ignis Finis.

// Dim the scene -> icy frost particles slowly gather AROUND the target, then are

// pulled violently INTO it -> the target tints blue as an ice-spikes burst forms

// over it; the burst FREEZES at ~2.0s to show the target trapped in ice (held for

// drama) -> then an ice shard shatter bursts on top with a screenshake AND a

// per-target token shake. doneHook fires at the shatter; then the dim fades out.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"name":"Glacies Finis","key":"master_glaciesfinis","frostColor":13434879,"tintColor":3381759,"tintAlpha":0.5,"dimAlpha":0.6,"dimMs":420,"undimMs":520,"shimmerColor":6728447,"shimmerAlpha":0.28,"shimmerMs":700,"gatherRadius":0.26,"gatherCount":30,"gatherSize":0.028,"gatherMs":760,"gatherStagger":7,"orbit":1.1,"gatherHoldMs":260,"pullMs":300,"iceSize":1.25,"holdAtSec":2.0,"freezeMaxMs":3200,"tintMs":220,"holdMs":820,"shardSize":1.2,"shardMaxMs":1400,"tintFadeMs":320,"doneAtMs":200,"shakeMs":620,"shakePx":12,"tokenShakeMs":520,"tokenShakePx":11,"fadeMs":340,"totalTimeoutMs":16000,"sfxStart":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Ice5.ogg","sfxStartVol":0.6,"sfxTrap":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_Ice1.mp3","sfxTrapVol":0.7,"sfxShatter":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Critical.wav","sfxShatterVol":0.5};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][GlaciesFinis][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.glaciesfinis." + CFG.key;

const ICE_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Ice/IceSpikesRadialBurst_01_Regular_White_1000x1000.webm";

const SHARD_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/ImpactIceShard01_01_Regular_Blue_400x400.webm";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

function fullRect(color, alpha, z, blend) {

const a = S2W(-0.1,-0.1), b = S2W(1.1,1.1);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, 1).drawRect(a.x, a.y, b.x-a.x, b.y-a.y).endFill();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z; if (blend) g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

return g;

}

function screenShake(ms, px) {

try {

const view = canvas.app.view;

if (!document.getElementById("oni-shake-kf")) {

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "oni-shake-kf";

st.textContent = "@keyframes oniShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}15%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px," + px + "px)}30%{transform:translate(" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}45%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}60%{transform:translate(" + px + "px," + px + "px)}75%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,0)}} .oni-shaking{animation:oniShake 0.42s linear}";

document.head.appendChild(st);

}

view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); void view.offsetWidth; view.classList.add("oni-shaking");

setTimeout(() => { try { view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); } catch(_){} }, ms);

} catch (_) {}

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

return vid;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

// Match the rendered token's mirror: mesh.scale sign folds in Mirror-Horizontal + facing.

const sgx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const sgy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y || 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sgx;

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sgy;

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok); let on = false, tR = true, mR = true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return {

start() { if (!tok || on) return; on = true; tR = tok.renderable ?? true; mR = m?.renderable ?? true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore() { if (!tok || !on) return; ticker.remove(guard); tok.renderable = tR; if (m) m.renderable = mR; try { tok.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {} on = false; },

};

}

async function tokenShake(tok, ms, px) {

if (!tok) return;

const hide = makeHider(tok);

const c = { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const spr = makeSprite(tok);

spr.x = c.x; spr.y = c.y; spr.zIndex = 8900;

try {

hide.start();

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

await tween((p) => { const d = 1 - p; spr.x = c.x + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; spr.y = c.y + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; }, ms, null);

} catch (_) {} finally {

destroyObj(spr); hide.restore();

}

}

// a blue, semi-transparent clone of the target's sprite laid ON TOP of the ice (frozen-in-ice look)

function frozenClone(tok, color, maxAlpha, z) {

if (!tok) return { fadeIn() { return Promise.resolve(); }, fadeOut() { return Promise.resolve(); } };

const c = { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const sp = makeSprite(tok);

sp.x = c.x; sp.y = c.y; sp.zIndex = z; sp.tint = color; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

return {

fadeIn(ms) { return tween((p) => { sp.alpha = maxAlpha * p; }, ms, easeOutCubic); },

fadeOut(ms) { return tween((p) => { sp.alpha = maxAlpha * (1 - p); }, ms, easeOutCubic).then(() => destroyObj(sp)); },

};

}

try {

const points = (targetTokens.length ? targetTokens : [caster])

.filter(Boolean)

.map(t => ({ x: t.center.x, y: t.center.y, tok: t }));

if (!points.length) points.push({ x: S2W(0.6,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.6,0.5).y, tok: null });

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.frostColor);

// 1) dim + startup sfx

playSfx(cfg.sfxStart, cfg.sfxStartVol);

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000, false);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 1b) element-colored screen shimmer at initialization (mirrors Ignis Finis)

const shim = fullRect(cfg.shimmerColor, 0, 7100, true);

stage.addChild(shim); spawned.push(shim);

tween((p) => { shim.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI) * cfg.shimmerAlpha; }, cfg.shimmerMs, null).then(() => destroyObj(shim));

// 2) frost particles slowly gather AROUND the target(s), then pull violently IN

const ringR = hPx(cfg.gatherRadius);

const parts = [];

for (const pt of points) {

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.gatherCount; i++) {

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r = ringR*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 7200; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.frostColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.gatherSize)*(0.6+Math.random()*0.8); sp.width = sp.height = sz;

sp.x = pt.x + Math.cos(ang)*r; sp.y = pt.y + Math.sin(ang)*r; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

parts.push({ sp, ang, r, cx: pt.x, cy: pt.y, i });

}

}

// Stage A: slow gather (fade in, drift inward, orbit)

await Promise.all(parts.map(({sp,ang,r,cx,cy,i}) => (async () => {

await waitMs((i % cfg.gatherCount) * (cfg.gatherStagger||7));

await tween((p) => {

const rr = r * (1 - 0.35*p);

const aa = ang + p*cfg.orbit;

sp.x = cx + Math.cos(aa)*rr; sp.y = cy + Math.sin(aa)*rr;

sp.alpha = Math.min(1, p*1.5);

}, cfg.gatherMs, easeOutCubic);

})()));

points.forEach(pt => { if (pt.tok) tokenShake(pt.tok, cfg.tokenShakeMs, cfg.tokenShakePx); });

frozen.forEach(f => f.fadeOut(cfg.tintFadeMs));

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

AH.play({ src: src, volume: volume == null ? 0.8 : volume, autoplay: true, loop: false }, true);

const INNER = [

"const p = ctx.params || {};",

"const vid = document.createElement('video'); vid.src = p.file; vid.muted = true; vid.playsInline = true; vid.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';",

"if (!tex) return;",

"const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;",

"const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);",

"const nw = (v && v.videoWidth) || tex.width || 100, nh = (v && v.videoHeight) || tex.height || 100;",

"const k = (p.scale || 1) * (canvas.grid.size / (p.fileGrid || 200));",

"spr.width = nw * k; spr.height = nh * k; if (p.mirrorX) spr.scale.x *= -1; if (p.mirrorY) spr.scale.y *= -1;",

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

0;

file: FX_PROTECT,

at: targetToken,

await PORT.wait(holdMs);

// Wait the remainder of pseudo return time so animationEnd happens after everything is done

// The old player also waited for the FX clip itself to finish

const fxLeft = (await fxDurP) - (performance.now() - fxStart);

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "skillProtect",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END", { moveOutMs, holdMs, moveBackMs, shouldFlipCaster });

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "skillProtect", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

(async () => {

const SHARD_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/ImpactIceShard01_01_Regular_Blue_400x400.webm";

}

const out = [];

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

let doneFired = false;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

}

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z; if (blend) g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

}

function screenShake(ms, px) {

try {

const view = canvas.app.view;

if (!document.getElementById("oni-shake-kf")) {

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "oni-shake-kf";

st.textContent = "@keyframes oniShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}15%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px," + px + "px)}30%{transform:translate(" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}45%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}60%{transform:translate(" + px + "px," + px + "px)}75%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,0)}} .oni-shaking{animation:oniShake 0.42s linear}";

document.head.appendChild(st);

}

view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); void view.offsetWidth; view.classList.add("oni-shaking");

setTimeout(() => { try { view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); } catch(_){} }, ms);

} catch (_) {}

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

return vid;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

// Match the rendered token's mirror: mesh.scale sign folds in Mirror-Horizontal + facing.

const sgx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const sgy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y || 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sgx;

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sgy;

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok); let on = false, tR = true, mR = true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return {

start() { if (!tok || on) return; on = true; tR = tok.renderable ?? true; mR = m?.renderable ?? true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore() { if (!tok || !on) return; ticker.remove(guard); tok.renderable = tR; if (m) m.renderable = mR; try { tok.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {} on = false; },

};

}

async function tokenShake(tok, ms, px) {

if (!tok) return;

const hide = makeHider(tok);

const c = { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const spr = makeSprite(tok);

spr.x = c.x; spr.y = c.y; spr.zIndex = 8900;

try {

hide.start();

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

await tween((p) => { const d = 1 - p; spr.x = c.x + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; spr.y = c.y + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; }, ms, null);

} catch (_) {} finally {

}

}

// a blue, semi-transparent clone of the target's sprite laid ON TOP of the ice (frozen-in-ice look)

function frozenClone(tok, color, maxAlpha, z) {

if (!tok) return { fadeIn() { return Promise.resolve(); }, fadeOut() { return Promise.resolve(); } };

const c = { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const sp = makeSprite(tok);

sp.x = c.x; sp.y = c.y; sp.zIndex = z; sp.tint = color; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

fadeIn(ms) { return tween((p) => { sp.alpha = maxAlpha * p; }, ms, easeOutCubic); },

fadeOut(ms) { return tween((p) => { sp.alpha = maxAlpha * (1 - p); }, ms, easeOutCubic).then(() => destroyObj(sp)); },

};

}

try {

const points = (targetTokens.length ? targetTokens : [caster])

.filter(Boolean)

.map(t => ({ x: t.center.x, y: t.center.y, tok: t }));

if (!points.length) points.push({ x: S2W(0.6,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.6,0.5).y, tok: null });

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.frostColor);

// 1) dim + startup sfx

playSfx(cfg.sfxStart, cfg.sfxStartVol);

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000, false);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 1b) element-colored screen shimmer at initialization (mirrors Ignis Finis)

const shim = fullRect(cfg.shimmerColor, 0, 7100, true);

stage.addChild(shim); spawned.push(shim);

tween((p) => { shim.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI) * cfg.shimmerAlpha; }, cfg.shimmerMs, null).then(() => destroyObj(shim));

// 2) frost particles slowly gather AROUND the target(s), then pull violently IN

const ringR = hPx(cfg.gatherRadius);

const parts = [];

for (const pt of points) {

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.gatherCount; i++) {

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r = ringR*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 7200; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.frostColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.gatherSize)*(0.6+Math.random()*0.8); sp.width = sp.height = sz;

sp.x = pt.x + Math.cos(ang)*r; sp.y = pt.y + Math.sin(ang)*r; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

parts.push({ sp, ang, r, cx: pt.x, cy: pt.y, i });

}

}

// Stage A: slow gather (fade in, drift inward, orbit)

await Promise.all(parts.map(({sp,ang,r,cx,cy,i}) => (async () => {

await waitMs((i % cfg.gatherCount) * (cfg.gatherStagger||7));

await tween((p) => {

const rr = r * (1 - 0.35*p);

const aa = ang + p*cfg.orbit;

sp.x = cx + Math.cos(aa)*rr; sp.y = cy + Math.sin(aa)*rr;

sp.alpha = Math.min(1, p*1.5);

}, cfg.gatherMs, easeOutCubic);

})()));

await waitMs(cfg.gatherHoldMs);

// Stage B: violent pull-in

await Promise.all(parts.map(({sp,cx,cy}) => {

const sx = sp.x, sy = sp.y, bs = sp.scale.x;

return tween((p) => { sp.x = sx + (cx-sx)*p; sp.y = sy + (cy-sy)*p; sp.scale.set(bs * (1 - 0.5*p)); }, cfg.pullMs, easeInCubic).then(() => destroyObj(sp));

}));

// 3) freeze: ice-spikes burst over each target; freeze at ~2.0s

const iceSprites = [];

const iceVids = [];

for (const pt of points) {

const vid = await loadVideo(A.ice);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nw = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 1000;

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); sp.x = pt.x; sp.y = pt.y; sp.zIndex = 8700;

sp.scale.set(hPx(cfg.iceSize) / nw);

sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.NORMAL;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

iceSprites.push(sp); iceVids.push(vid);

}

// frozen target: blue, semi-transparent clone of the target sprite ON TOP of the ice

const frozen = points.map(pt => frozenClone(pt.tok, cfg.tintColor, cfg.tintAlpha, 8750));

frozen.forEach(f => f.fadeIn(cfg.tintMs));

playSfx(cfg.sfxTrap, cfg.sfxTrapVol); // icy hit AS the spikes come up (synced to the vfx erupting)

// wait until the primary burst reaches ~holdAtSec, then FREEZE every burst

const gate = iceVids[0];

await new Promise((res) => {

let done = false; const go = () => { if (done) return; done = true; res(); };

const check = () => { if (done) return; if (!gate || gate.currentTime >= cfg.holdAtSec) go(); else setTimeout(check, 30); };

if (gate) gate.addEventListener("ended", go, { once: true });

setTimeout(check, 30); setTimeout(go, cfg.freezeMaxMs);

});

for (const vid of iceVids) { try { vid.pause(); } catch (_) {} }

await waitMs(cfg.holdMs); // hold on the frozen frame for drama

// 4) shatter: ice shard burst on top + shakes

const shSprites = [];

const shVids = [];

for (const pt of points) {

const vid = await loadVideo(A.shard);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nw = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 400;

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); sp.x = pt.x; sp.y = pt.y; sp.zIndex = 8800;

sp.scale.set(hPx(cfg.shardSize) / nw);

sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

shSprites.push(sp); shVids.push(vid);

}

playSfx(cfg.sfxShatter, cfg.sfxShatterVol); // ice shattered

screenShake(cfg.shakeMs, cfg.shakePx);

points.forEach(pt => { if (pt.tok) tokenShake(pt.tok, cfg.tokenShakeMs, cfg.tokenShakePx); });

frozen.forEach(f => f.fadeOut(cfg.tintFadeMs));

await waitMs(cfg.doneAtMs);

fireDone({ ok: true });

// fade the shard + frozen burst, then undim

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; if (shVids[0]) shVids[0].addEventListener("ended",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go, cfg.shardMaxMs); });

await tween((p) => { for (const sp of shSprites) sp.alpha = 1 - p; for (const sp of iceSprites) sp.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.fadeMs, easeOutCubic);

for (const sp of shSprites) destroyObj(sp);

for (const sp of iceSprites) destroyObj(sp);

for (const vid of iceVids) { try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {} }

for (const vid of shVids) { try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {} }

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * (1 - p); }, cfg.undimMs, easeOutCubic);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][GlaciesFinis]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 16000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// @desc Sunflower Staff Solar Beam: a sun swells at the staff, a fixed horizontal beam of sunlight swells across the field until the screen whites out to the enemies' silhouettes (pixelfx originals)

"use strict";

// Solar Beam (Sunflower Staff, All Enemy, 75 Light at 5 Solar Charge, split). Approved on the review mockup

// 2026-11-09/10 (rounds 3-5). Our own pixel effects: fu/solar-charge (pxfx_light_solar_charge) and

// fu/solar-cannon (pxfx_light_solar_cannon: one 1920x400 clip, the beam swells and burns white).

//

// Beats: sun swells at the staff | the beam fires straight across toward the enemies (fixed horizontal, not

// aimed) and keeps swelling, the field rumbles | the screen slowly whites out, every enemy left as a black

// silhouette — DAMAGE lands at full white | the white drains away.

//

// DAMAGE TIMING: "default" → gate = oni:animationEnd, fired at full white (oni.fireDone()).

(async () => {

const FORGE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/";

const PX = FORGE + "Animation/pixelfx/";

const CFG = {

S: FORGE + "Sound/",

charge: { base: PX + "pxfx_light_solar_charge", width: 256, anchor: { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 } },

cannon: { base: PX + "pxfx_light_solar_cannon", width: 1920, anchor: { x: 0.0167, y: 0.5 } },

chargeK: 0.85, // charge sun size on top of the caster's depth scale

chargePeakMs: 1150, // the charge clip's peak: the beam fires here

whiteAtMs: 1700, // after the beam fires, the screen starts whiting out

whiteMs: 1150, // slow whiteout

silFrom: 0.5, // silhouettes appear from this whiteness

holdMs: 650, // full white + silhouettes

backMs: 700, // white drains away

chest: 0.55, staffFwd: 22,

volume: 0.8,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

// INNER (every client). No backticks and no dollar-brace inside.

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const caster = oni.caster;

const targets = oni.targets || [];

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const st = globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__;

const bounds = (t) => { const b = st && st.drawnMeshBounds ? st.drawnMeshBounds(t) : null; return b && Number.isFinite(b.x) ? b : null; };

const drawn = (t) => {

const b = bounds(t);

if (b) {

const W = canvas.stage.worldTransform;

const feet = W.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y + b.height));

const top = W.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y));

return { feet: feet, chest: { x: feet.x, y: feet.y + (top.y - feet.y) * cfg.chest }, m: b.width / Math.abs(t.mesh.width || b.width) };

}

return { feet: { x: t.center.x, y: t.y + t.h }, chest: { x: t.center.x, y: t.center.y }, m: 1 };

};

const A = drawn(caster);

// which way the enemies are: the average of the targets (party fires left, enemies fire right)

let tx = 0; for (const t of targets) tx += drawn(t).chest.x;

const dir = targets.length ? ((tx / targets.length) >= A.chest.x ? 1 : -1) : -1, mirror = dir < 0;

const sx = A.chest.x + dir * cfg.staffFwd * A.m, sy = A.chest.y;

// 1. The sun swells at the staff.

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Absorb1.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.4 });

const charge = await oni.pxfx(cfg.charge, { x: sx, y: sy, k: cfg.chargeK * A.m });

await oni.wait(cfg.chargePeakMs);

// 2. The beam: fixed horizontal from the staff, sized to reach past the far edge of the screen.

const sc = oni.screen();

const left = sc.S2W(0, 0).x, right = sc.S2W(1, 0).x;

const far = dir < 0 ? sx - left : right - sx;

const k = Math.max(1, (far * 1.08) / (cfg.cannon.width * (1 - cfg.cannon.anchor.x)));

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Saint5.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.5 });

const cannon = await oni.pxfx(cfg.cannon, { x: sx, y: sy, mirror: mirror, k: k });

setTimeout(() => { for (const f of (charge.parts || [])) { try { f.sprite.destroy(); } catch (e) {} } }, 300);

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.whiteAtMs + cfg.whiteMs, intensity: 4 });

await oni.wait(240);

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Flash1.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.45 });

await oni.wait(Math.max(0, cfg.whiteAtMs - 240));

// 3. Whiteout: a screen-locked white sheet, the enemies as black silhouettes over it.

const L = oni.layer({ zIndex: 100000 });

const white = new PIXI.Graphics();

const tl = sc.S2W(0, 0);

white.beginFill(0xffffff, 1).drawRect(tl.x, tl.y, sc.wLen(sc.W), sc.wLen(sc.H)).endFill();

white.alpha = 0; L.addChild(white);

const sils = [];

for (const t of targets) {

const b = bounds(t), mesh = t.mesh;

if (!mesh || !mesh.texture) continue;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(mesh.texture);

spr.tint = 0x000000; spr.alpha = 0; spr.zIndex = 10;

if (b) {

const p0 = canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(b.x, b.y));

spr.position.set(p0.x, p0.y); spr.width = b.width / sc.zoom; spr.height = b.height / sc.zoom;

} else {

spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); spr.position.set(mesh.x, mesh.y); spr.width = Math.abs(mesh.width); spr.height = Math.abs(mesh.height);

}

if ((mesh.scale && mesh.scale.x) < 0) { spr.anchor.x = 1 - spr.anchor.x; spr.scale.x *= -1; if (b) spr.x += 0; }

L.addChild(spr); sils.push(spr);

}

await oni.tween({ duration: cfg.whiteMs, ease: (u) => u * u, onUpdate: (u) => {

white.alpha = u;

const s = Math.max(0, (u - cfg.silFrom) / (1 - cfg.silFrom));

for (const spr of sils) spr.alpha = s;

} });

// full white: the damage lands; the beam is gone when it drains

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Flash1.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.5 });

oni.fireDone();

for (const f of (cannon.parts || [])) { try { f.video.pause(); f.sprite.destroy(); } catch (e) {} }

await oni.wait(cfg.holdMs);

// 4. The white drains away.

await oni.tween({ duration: cfg.backMs, ease: (u) => 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u), onUpdate: (u) => {

white.alpha = 1 - u;

for (const spr of sils) spr.alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - u * 2);

} });

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/sunflower-solar-beam",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.chargePeakMs + CFG.whiteAtMs + CFG.whiteMs + 8000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

await tl.load();

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

}

});

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

// ── shot ──

// Hina: the wisp spells (approved mockup, Round 2). cfg.mode picks one:

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Hina: the cast-then-clip spells (approved mockup). cfg.mode picks one:

// glacies | iceberg | heal | cleanse | dispel | shroud | weapon | bind

// Shape: step out 46, cast sound, RO hexagram circle in the school colour (700 ms

// hold), release + step back, then the MV clip on each target. Heal is shared by

// every caster (Hina, Blanche, class parents): the caster is whoever casts.

// A self-target (caster in the target list) gets the clip on the caster too.

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const mode = cfg.mode;

const selfT = (ctx.targetTokens || []).some((x) => x && x.id === caster.id);

if (!targets.length && !selfT && mode !== 'bind') { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t; const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const ALL = TG.concat(selfT ? ['c'] : []); const NT = ALL.length;

const at = (k, pos) => pos === 'feet' ? K.feet(tl, k) : K.mid(tl, k);

const fx = (key, tt, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const d = A.clips[key]; if (!d) return; m.clip(key, tt, { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, w: d.w * 0.85 * (o.scale || 1) * (d.ro ? 1.9 : 1) * U, z: o.z || 50, add: !!o.add, filter: o.filter }); };

const hurt = (tt, k) => { m.tint(tt, 220, k, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.6 * (1 - u)); const d = -K.dirOf(TOK, k); m.hold(tt, tt + 300, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (q) q.dx += d * Math.sin(e / 300 * Math.PI * 4) * 9 * U * (1 - e / 300); }); };

const flashA = (tt, k) => m.tint(tt, 220, k, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.6 * (1 - u));

const R = t.rel;

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back || R, 46);

K.circle(tl, m, U, 'c', 380, R - 380, cfg.hue, { dx: dir * 46 * U, scale: t.scale });

if (mode === 'glacies') {

// frost burst on each target, 160 ms apart; damage on each burst (impact 200)

TG.forEach((k, i) => { fx('ice1', R + i * 160, at(k, 'mid')); hurt(R + i * 160 + 200, k); });

} else if (mode === 'iceberg') {

const k = TG[0] || 'c';

fx('ice2', R, at(k, 'feet'), { scale: 1.75 }); m.shake(R + 200, 380, 14 * U); hurt(R + 200, k);

} else if (mode === 'heal') {

ALL.forEach((k, i) => fx('heal', R + i * 140, at(k, 'feet')));

} else if (mode === 'cleanse') {

ALL.forEach((k, i) => fx('cure', R + i * 140, at(k, 'feet')));

} else if (mode === 'dispel') {

const k = ALL[0]; const c = at(k, 'mid');

fx('neutral', R, c); flashA(R + 67, k); K.shards(tl, m, R + 67, c, '#ffd36a', 16, 160, U, 11);

} else if (mode === 'shroud') {

// The player picks the element at resolve and the shot cannot see it: the crest

// plays UNTINTED (053_powerup_3's own colour) with the circle at its native hue.

ALL.forEach((k, i) => fx('pu3', R + i * 140, at(k, 'mid')));

} else if (mode === 'weapon') {

// Same: no element known here, so the sparks and the power-up keep 052's native gold.

const k = ALL[0]; const f = K.feet(tl, k); const hand = { x: f.x + K.dirOf(TOK, k) * 34 * U, y: f.y - TOK[k].h * 0.45 };

K.twinkles(m, R, hand, K.tintF(cfg.hue, 4, 1.3), 7, 30, U);

fx('pu2', R + 400, at(k, 'feet'));

} else if (mode === 'bind') {

// class default: big gold circle, a light pillar at the summon spot, white flash

m.dim(0, 500, 0.35);

fx('pillar', R, K.summonSpot(tl, 'c'), { scale: 1.4 });

m.flash(R + 1200, 100, 300, '#ffffff', 0.6);

m.undim(R + 2467, 500, 0.35);

}

await tl.run(T, { total: t.total, sfx: (cfg.sfx || []).filter((c) => !c.n || c.n <= NT), onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Elemental Shroud" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

// @desc Sunflower Staff Solar Charge +1: light streams from the creature that took Light damage into Hina's staff; the five-petal sunflower over her lights its next petal

"use strict";

// Played by the staff passive's chain (apply_ae Solar Charge, then play_animation) whenever one action deals

// Light damage to any creature. Caster = the staff's wearer, target = the creature that took the Light damage.

// Approved on the review mockup 2026-11-09 ("Solar Charge +1").

//

// Not an action of Hina's, so it never holds the battle up: the gate fires at once (oni.fireDone() first)

// and the stream + sunflower play out over the next ~1.8 s.

(async () => {

const CFG = {

S: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/",

motes: 14, streamMs: 750, holdMs: 800, foldMs: 350,

petalR: 30, // the sunflower's radius, px at depth 1

chest: 0.5, staffFwd: 22,

volume: 0.8,

maxCharge: 5,

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

// how many charges Hina holds now (the chain applied the new one first)

let charges = 1;

try {

const tok = casterUuid ? fromUuidSync(casterUuid) : null;

const eff = tok?.actor?.effects?.find((e) => e.name === "Solar Charge");

charges = Number(eff?.flags?.["fabula-ultima-companion"]?.charges ?? 1) || 1;

} catch (e) {}

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

// INNER (every client). No backticks and no dollar-brace inside.

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(cfg.maxCharge, ctx.params.charges || 1));

oni.fireDone();

const caster = oni.caster, src = oni.targets[0] || null;

if (!caster) return;

const st = globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__;

const drawn = (t) => {

const b = st && st.drawnMeshBounds ? st.drawnMeshBounds(t) : null;

if (b && Number.isFinite(b.x)) {

const W = canvas.stage.worldTransform;

const feet = W.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y + b.height));

const top = W.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y));

return { feet: feet, top: top, chest: { x: feet.x, y: feet.y + (top.y - feet.y) * cfg.chest }, m: b.width / Math.abs(t.mesh.width || b.width) };

}

return { feet: { x: t.center.x, y: t.y + t.h }, top: { x: t.center.x, y: t.y }, chest: { x: t.center.x, y: t.center.y }, m: 1 };

};

const A = drawn(caster);

const dir = src ? (drawn(src).chest.x >= A.chest.x ? 1 : -1) : -1;

const sx = A.chest.x + dir * cfg.staffFwd * A.m, sy = A.chest.y;

const L = oni.layer({ zIndex: 95200 });

// 1. Light streams from the creature that was hit into the staff.

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Absorb1.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.3 });

if (src && src !== caster) {

const B = drawn(src);

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.motes; i++) {

const g = new PIXI.Graphics(); g.beginFill(0xffd76a, 1).drawRect(-2, -2, 4, 4).endFill();

g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; g.alpha = 0; L.addChild(g);

const x0 = B.chest.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40 * B.m, y0 = B.chest.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 50 * B.m;

const cx = (x0 + sx) / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 120, cy = Math.min(y0, sy) - 40 - Math.random() * 90;

const delay = Math.random() * 300;

setTimeout(() => oni.tween({ duration: cfg.streamMs * (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3), onUpdate: (u) => {

const e = u * u, v = 1 - e;

g.x = v * v * x0 + 2 * v * e * cx + e * e * sx; g.y = v * v * y0 + 2 * v * e * cy + e * e * sy;

g.alpha = Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * 0.9 + 0.1;

} }).then(() => { try { g.destroy(); } catch (e) {} }), delay);

}

await oni.wait(cfg.streamMs + 200);

}

oni.particles({ x: sx, y: sy, mode: 'burst', count: 10, color: 0xfff0a0, size: 5, radius: 24 * A.m, life: 450, blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD });

// 2. The sunflower over her head: five petals, the stored ones lit, the new one pops.

const R = cfg.petalR * A.m, hx = A.top.x, hy = A.top.y - R - 14 * A.m;

const flower = new PIXI.Container(); flower.position.set(hx, hy); flower.alpha = 0; flower.scale.set(0.6); L.addChild(flower);

const petals = [];

for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

const p = new PIXI.Graphics(); p.rotation = (i * 72 - 90) * Math.PI / 180;

p.paint = (lit) => { p.clear(); p.lineStyle(2 * A.m, lit ? 0xfff6d4 : 0xd4bb5f, 1).beginFill(lit ? 0xf6cf3e : 0x3c280a, lit ? 1 : 0.55).drawEllipse(R * 0.62, 0, R * 0.5, R * 0.24).endFill(); };

p.paint(i < n - 1); flower.addChild(p); petals.push(p);

}

const core = new PIXI.Graphics(); core.lineStyle(2 * A.m, 0xf2dc8a, 1).beginFill(0x5a3e10, 1).drawCircle(0, 0, R * 0.3).endFill(); flower.addChild(core);

await oni.tween({ duration: 260, onUpdate: (u) => { flower.alpha = Math.min(1, u * 1.4); flower.scale.set(0.6 + 0.4 * u + 0.12 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI)); } });

flower.scale.set(1);

const np = petals[n - 1]; np.paint(true);

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Starlight.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.35 });

await oni.tween({ duration: 260, onUpdate: (u) => np.scale.set(1 + 0.35 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI)) });

await oni.wait(cfg.holdMs);

await oni.tween({ duration: cfg.foldMs, onUpdate: (u) => { flower.alpha = 1 - u; flower.scale.set(1 - 0.15 * u); } });

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/sunflower-solar-charge",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, charges },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, 3000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

// PORTED (Batch C, 2026-11-05): old effect-player calls replaced by the PORT shim

// (_port-shim.js, header comment trimmed). Same look and timing as the legacy script.

// PORT.sound = AudioHelper broadcast; PORT.effect = webm via game.ONI.pseudo.play; PORT.wait.

// Pseudo inners hide tokens with oni.hideToken (guarded), never by toggling visibility.

const PORT = (() => {

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

function sound(src, volume) {

if (!src) return;

try {

const AH = (foundry && foundry.audio && foundry.audio.AudioHelper) || globalThis.AudioHelper;

AH.play({ src: src, volume: volume == null ? 0.8 : volume, autoplay: true, loop: false }, true);

} catch (e) { console.warn('[PORT] sound failed', src, e); }

}

const INNER = [

"const p = ctx.params || {};",

"const vid = document.createElement('video'); vid.src = p.file; vid.muted = true; vid.playsInline = true; vid.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';",

"let tex; try { tex = await loadTexture(p.file); } catch (e) { tex = null; }",

"if (!tex) return;",

"const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;",

"const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);",

"const nw = (v && v.videoWidth) || tex.width || 100, nh = (v && v.videoHeight) || tex.height || 100;",

"const k = (p.scale || 1) * (canvas.grid.size / (p.fileGrid || 200));",

"spr.width = nw * k; spr.height = nh * k; if (p.mirrorX) spr.scale.x *= -1; if (p.mirrorY) spr.scale.y *= -1;",

"spr.angle = -(p.rotate || 0); spr.x = p.x; spr.y = p.y; spr.alpha = p.fadeIn ? 0 : (p.opacity == null ? 1 : p.opacity);",

"spr.zIndex = p.below ? 50 : 100500; canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(spr); canvas.stage.sortChildren();",

"const op = p.opacity == null ? 1 : p.opacity;",

"if (v) { try { v.loop = false; v.currentTime = 0; v.playbackRate = p.rate || 1; await v.play(); } catch (e) {} }",

"const dur = p.duration || ((v && isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration * 1000 / (p.rate || 1) : 1000));",

"const t0 = performance.now();",

"await new Promise((res) => { const tick = () => { const e = performance.now() - t0; let a = op; if (p.fadeIn && e < p.fadeIn) a = op * e / p.fadeIn; if (p.fadeOut && e > dur - p.fadeOut) a = op * Math.max(0, (dur - e) / p.fadeOut); spr.alpha = a; if (e >= dur) { canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick); res(); } }; canvas.app.ticker.add(tick); });",

"try { spr.destroy(); } catch (e) {} try { if (v) v.pause(); } catch (e) {}",

].join("\n");

function fileGrid() { return 100; } // raw file path default: native px x scale x (scene grid / 100)

async function effect(o) {

let x = 0, y = 0;

const at = o.at && o.at.center ? o.at.center : (o.at || { x: 0, y: 0 });

x = at.x + ((o.offset && o.offset.x) || 0); y = at.y + ((o.offset && o.offset.y) || 0);

const params = { file: o.file, x, y, scale: o.scale, mirrorX: !!o.mirrorX, mirrorY: !!o.mirrorY, rotate: o.rotate || 0, fadeIn: o.fadeIn || 0, fadeOut: o.fadeOut || 0, below: !!o.below, opacity: o.opacity, duration: o.duration || 0, rate: o.rate || 1, fileGrid: o.fileGrid || fileGrid(o.file) };

try { await game.ONI.pseudo.play({ scriptId: 'port.effect', scriptSource: INNER, casterTokenUuid: null, targetTokenUuids: [], params }); } catch (e) { console.warn('[PORT] effect failed', o.file, e); }

}

return { sound, effect, wait };

})();

// ── Port helper (this script only) ──────────────────────────────────────────

// PORT.effect resolves as soon as the broadcast is sent; the old player's play()

// resolved when its effects finished. To keep the legacy end timing, read the

// clip length here on the GM (metadata only) and wait it out explicitly.

function __fxDurMs(file, fallback) {

return new Promise((res) => {

const v = document.createElement('video');

let done = false;

const fin = (d) => { if (done) return; done = true; try { v.removeAttribute('src'); v.load(); } catch (e) {} res(d); };

v.preload = 'metadata'; v.muted = true;

v.onloadedmetadata = () => fin(isFinite(v.duration) && v.duration > 0 ? v.duration * 1000 : fallback);

v.onerror = () => fin(fallback);

setTimeout(() => fin(fallback), 4000);

v.src = file;

});

}

// ONI — Clockwork Blades (polished: X-only sidestep, no Y drift) — ported (PORT shim)

// The sidestep is now a pseudo clone (visual only, every client): the real token

// never moves and is hidden with oni.hideToken while the clone steps out/back.

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][FX]";

// --- Assets ---

const SFX_MOVE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const FX_TARGET = "modules/boss-loot-assets-free/artwork/07-steampunk/clock/Clockwork_Blades_1_1200x1200.webm";

const SFX_TARGET = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Haste.ogg";

// --- Checks ---

const caster = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0];

if (!caster) {

ui.notifications.warn(`${TAG} Please SELECT exactly 1 token (the caster).`);

return;

}

const targets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

if (targets.length !== 1) {

ui.notifications.warn(`${TAG} Please TARGET exactly 1 token.`);

return;

}

const target = targets[0];

// --- X-only sidestep distance ---

const disp = caster.document.disposition;

const squares = 0.35; // tweak distance here

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

// Hostile (-1) => move RIGHT, else => move LEFT

const dx = (disp === -1) ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

const MOVE_MS = 350;

const PAUSE_MS = 500;

// The clone holds out for: pause + target FX (full clip) + pause

const fxDur = await __fxDurMs(FX_TARGET, 1500);

const holdMs = PAUSE_MS + fxDur + PAUSE_MS;

const stepInner = [

"const { casterToken, params } = ctx;",

"if (!casterToken) return;",

"const dx = Number(params.dx || 0), dur = Number(params.dur || 350), hold = Number(params.hold || 0);",

"const clone = oni.cloneToken(casterToken);",

"if (!clone) return;",

}

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

};

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const K = {};

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.
