// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

};

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const out = [];

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Hina: the cast-then-clip spells (approved mockup). cfg.mode picks one:

// glacies | iceberg | heal | cleanse | dispel | shroud | weapon | bind

// Shape: step out 46, cast sound, RO hexagram circle in the school colour (700 ms

// hold), release + step back, then the MV clip on each target. Heal is shared by

// every caster (Hina, Blanche, class parents): the caster is whoever casts.

// A self-target (caster in the target list) gets the clip on the caster too.

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const mode = cfg.mode;

const selfT = (ctx.targetTokens || []).some((x) => x && x.id === caster.id);

if (!targets.length && !selfT && mode !== 'bind') { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t; const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const ALL = TG.concat(selfT ? ['c'] : []); const NT = ALL.length;

const at = (k, pos) => pos === 'feet' ? K.feet(tl, k) : K.mid(tl, k);

const fx = (key, tt, pt, o) => { o = o || {}; const d = A.clips[key]; if (!d) return; m.clip(key, tt, { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, w: d.w * 0.85 * (o.scale || 1) * (d.ro ? 1.9 : 1) * U, z: o.z || 50, add: !!o.add, filter: o.filter }); };

const hurt = (tt, k) => { m.tint(tt, 220, k, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.6 * (1 - u)); const d = -K.dirOf(TOK, k); m.hold(tt, tt + 300, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (q) q.dx += d * Math.sin(e / 300 * Math.PI * 4) * 9 * U * (1 - e / 300); }); };

const flashA = (tt, k) => m.tint(tt, 220, k, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.6 * (1 - u));

const R = t.rel;

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back || R, 46);

K.circle(tl, m, U, 'c', 380, R - 380, cfg.hue, { dx: dir * 46 * U, scale: t.scale });

if (mode === 'glacies') {

// frost burst on each target, 160 ms apart; damage on each burst (impact 200)

TG.forEach((k, i) => { fx('ice1', R + i * 160, at(k, 'mid')); hurt(R + i * 160 + 200, k); });

} else if (mode === 'iceberg') {

const k = TG[0] || 'c';

fx('ice2', R, at(k, 'feet'), { scale: 1.75 }); m.shake(R + 200, 380, 14 * U); hurt(R + 200, k);

} else if (mode === 'heal') {

ALL.forEach((k, i) => fx('heal', R + i * 140, at(k, 'feet')));

} else if (mode === 'cleanse') {

ALL.forEach((k, i) => fx('cure', R + i * 140, at(k, 'feet')));

} else if (mode === 'dispel') {

const k = ALL[0]; const c = at(k, 'mid');

fx('neutral', R, c); flashA(R + 67, k); K.shards(tl, m, R + 67, c, '#ffd36a', 16, 160, U, 11);

} else if (mode === 'shroud') {

// The player picks the element at resolve and the shot cannot see it: the crest

// plays UNTINTED (053_powerup_3's own colour) with the circle at its native hue.

ALL.forEach((k, i) => fx('pu3', R + i * 140, at(k, 'mid')));

} else if (mode === 'weapon') {

// Same: no element known here, so the sparks and the power-up keep 052's native gold.

const k = ALL[0]; const f = K.feet(tl, k); const hand = { x: f.x + K.dirOf(TOK, k) * 34 * U, y: f.y - TOK[k].h * 0.45 };

K.twinkles(m, R, hand, K.tintF(cfg.hue, 4, 1.3), 7, 30, U);

fx('pu2', R + 400, at(k, 'feet'));

} else if (mode === 'bind') {

// class default: big gold circle, a light pillar at the summon spot, white flash

m.dim(0, 500, 0.35);

fx('pillar', R, K.summonSpot(tl, 'c'), { scale: 1.4 });

m.flash(R + 1200, 100, 300, '#ffffff', 0.6);

m.undim(R + 2467, 500, 0.35);

}

await tl.run(T, { total: t.total, sfx: (cfg.sfx || []).filter((c) => !c.n || c.n <= NT), onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Elemental Weapon" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// ⭐ Wandering Flame — Zero Power: Meteor Impact (cinematic finisher)

// =============================================================================

// OUTER script: runs on the GM client (BD ANIMATION state). Resolves the

// caster + party targets, builds the PIXI "scriptSource", and broadcasts it to

// every client via game.ONI.pseudo.play. A per-run doneHook fires at the

// meteor's impact (whiteout peak); the outer then emits oni:animationEnd so BD

// applies the skill's damage on impact. All beats are drawn as PIXI objects on

// canvas.stage and driven by canvas.app.ticker tweens.

//

// Never emits on the reserved "world" socket (host-crash class) — cross-client

// playback is the pseudo channel; hook emits are local-only.

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][ZeroPower][MeteorImpact]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.zeroPower.meteorImpact";

playAudio(A.charge, cfg.chargeVol * 0.6, 0.8);

const C = S2W(cfg.zoomCenterX, cfg.zoomCenterY);

const mHome = { x: meteor.x, y: meteor.y, s: Math.abs(meteor.width) };

const wHome = { x: wfSky.x, y: wfSky.y, w: Math.abs(wfSky.width), h: Math.abs(wfSky.height) };

await tween((f) => {

if (!alive(meteor)) throw 0;

meteor.x = (mHome.x - C.x) * f + C.x; meteor.y = (mHome.y - C.y) * f + C.y;

sizeSquare(meteor, mHome.s * f);

if (alive(glow)) { glow.x = meteor.x; glow.y = meteor.y; sizeSquare(glow, mHome.s * f * cfg.meteorGlowMul); }

if (alive(wfSky)) {

wfSky.x = (wHome.x - C.x) * f + C.x; wfSky.y = (wHome.y - C.y) * f + C.y;

wfSky.width = wHome.w * f; wfSky.height = wHome.h * f;

wfSky.scale.x = Math.abs(wfSky.scale.x) * casterSignX;

}

}, 1, cfg.zoomOutScale, cfg.zoomOutMs, easeInOutCubic);

await waitMs(cfg.zoomHoldMs);

// ---- Beat 4: throw the meteor diagonally SE (shrinks with distance) ---

const wfHomeX = wfSky.x;

await tweenXY(wfSky, wfHomeX, wfHomeX - hPx(0.04), wfSky.y, wfSky.y, cfg.throwWindupMs, easeOutCubic);

playAudio(A.whoosh, cfg.whooshVol, 0.9);

const throwEnd = S2W(cfg.throwOffX, cfg.throwOffY);

const throwS = Math.abs(meteor.width) || maxS;

await Promise.all([

tweenXY(wfSky, wfSky.x, wfHomeX + hPx(0.03), wfSky.y, wfSky.y, cfg.throwMs * 0.45, easeOutCubic),

tweenXY(meteor, meteor.x, throwEnd.x, meteor.y, throwEnd.y, cfg.throwMs, easeInCubic,

(t) => { const s = throwS * lerp(1, 0.26, t); sizeSquare(meteor, s); if (alive(glow)) { glow.x = meteor.x; glow.y = meteor.y; sizeSquare(glow, s * cfg.meteorGlowMul); } meteor.rotation += 0.06; }),

]);

destroyObj(meteor); destroyObj(glow);

// ---- Beat 5: pan down to BLACK, then lift the curtain ----------------

// A black curtain sits BELOW the sky so sliding the sky up reveals BLACK, not

// the live scene (fixes the "overlay peeling off a static battlefield" look).

// Then the curtain lifts up + fades = camera-pan-down illusion. No real camera

// motion, so any per-client camera lock/zoom can't desync it.

const curtain = new PIXI.Graphics();

const cuTL = S2W(-0.25, -0.3), cuBR = S2W(1.25, 1.3);

curtain.beginFill(0x000000, 1);

curtain.drawRect(cuTL.x, cuTL.y, cuBR.x - cuTL.x, cuBR.y - cuTL.y);

curtain.endFill();

addChildTo(stage, curtain, cfg.zSky - 2); track(curtain);

// Pan to black: slide the sky up off the top → the curtain (black) shows.

await tween(v => { if (!alive(skyView)) throw 0; skyView.y = v; }, 0, -H_world, cfg.panDownMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(skyView);

await waitMs(cfg.panBlackHoldMs);

// Reveal: lift the curtain up + fade out → battlefield "slides" into view.

await tween((_v, t) => {

if (!alive(curtain)) throw 0;

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

curtain.y = -H_world * e; // slide up by a full screen height

curtain.alpha = 1 - e; // fade as it lifts

}, 0, 1, cfg.panRevealMs, (x)=>x);

destroyObj(curtain);

await waitMs(cfg.battlefieldHoldMs);

// ---- Beat 6: the meteor crashes onto the party (big, slow, impending) -

const crashStart = S2W(cfg.crashStartX, cfg.crashStartY);

// Growing ground-shadow telegraph under the impact point.

const shadow = makeRadial("rgba(15,8,4,0.8)", "rgba(15,8,4,0.35)");

shadow.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.NORMAL;

shadow.x = impactW.x; shadow.y = impactW.y;

sizeSquare(shadow, hPx(0.05)); shadow.scale.y *= 0.5; shadow.alpha = 0;

addChildTo(stage, shadow, cfg.zShadow); track(shadow);

const crash = await makeVideoSprite(A.meteor, true);

crash.x = crashStart.x; crash.y = crashStart.y;

sizeSquare(crash, hPx(cfg.crashStartSizeH));

addChildTo(stage, crash, cfg.zProjectile); track(crash);

const ctrail = makeRadial("rgba(255,210,140,0.9)", "rgba(255,80,10,0.55)");

addChildTo(stage, ctrail, cfg.zProjectile - 1); track(ctrail);

// Hang ominously at the top, then plunge (easeIn = slow → SLAM).

await waitMs(cfg.crashHangMs);

playAudio(A.whoosh, cfg.whooshVol * 0.8, 0.7);

await tweenXY(crash, crashStart.x, impactW.x, crashStart.y, impactW.y, cfg.crashInMs, easeInCubic,

(t) => {

const s = hPx(lerp(cfg.crashStartSizeH, cfg.crashEndSizeH, t));

sizeSquare(crash, s); crash.rotation += 0.05;

if (alive(ctrail)) { ctrail.x = crash.x; ctrail.y = crash.y; sizeSquare(ctrail, s * 1.5); ctrail.alpha = 0.85 * (1 - t) + 0.15; }

if (alive(shadow)) { const ss = hPx(lerp(0.05, cfg.shadowMaxSizeH, t)); shadow.width = ss; shadow.height = ss * 0.5; shadow.alpha = 0.2 + 0.65 * t; }

});

destroyObj(crash); destroyObj(ctrail); destroyObj(shadow);

// Impact: explosion + shake + boom.

const boom = await makeVideoSprite(A.explosion, false);

boom.x = impactW.x; boom.y = impactW.y;

sizeSquare(boom, hPx(cfg.explosionSizeH));

addChildTo(stage, boom, cfg.zExplosion); track(boom);

screenShake();

playAudio(A.impact, cfg.impactVol, 1.0);

if (boom._vid) boom._vid.addEventListener("ended", () => destroyObj(boom), { once: true });

// ---- Beat 7: whiteout — damage lands here ----------------------------

const white = new PIXI.Graphics();

white.beginFill(0xffffff, 1);

white.drawRect(coverTL.x, coverTL.y, coverW, coverH);

white.endFill();

white.alpha = 0;

addChildTo(stage, white, cfg.zWhite); track(white);

await fadeAlpha(white, 0, 1, cfg.whiteInMs, easeInOutCubic);

fireDone({ ok: true }); // <-- BD applies the skill's damage now

await waitMs(cfg.whiteHoldMs);

destroyObj(boom);

// ---- Beat 8: WF falls back to its original position ------------------

const faller = track(makeCasterClone());

faller.x = homeX; faller.y = S2W(0.5, -0.3).y;

addChildTo(stage, faller, cfg.zCaster);

await fadeAlpha(white, 1, 0, cfg.whiteOutMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(white);

await tweenXY(faller, faller.x, homeX, faller.y, homeY, cfg.fallInMs, easeInCubic);

// landing squash + dust

playAudio(A.land, cfg.landVol, 1.0);

const dust = makeRadial("rgba(255,230,190,0.85)", "rgba(180,120,70,0.4)");

dust.x = homeX; dust.y = homeY + hPx(0.02);

sizeSquare(dust, hPx(cfg.dustSizeH) * 0.5); dust.alpha = 0.9;

addChildTo(stage, dust, cfg.zCaster - 1); track(dust);

await Promise.all([

tween(v => { if (!alive(faller)) throw 0; faller.scale.y = Math.abs(faller.scale.y) * (v < 0.5 ? lerp(1, 0.8, v*2) : lerp(0.8, 1, (v-0.5)*2)); }, 0, 1, cfg.landSquashMs, easeInOutCubic),

tween(v => { if (alive(dust)) { sizeSquare(dust, hPx(cfg.dustSizeH) * (0.5 + v)); dust.alpha = 0.9 * (1 - v); } }, 0, 1, cfg.landSquashMs * 2, easeOutCubic),

]);

destroyObj(dust);

restoreCaster();

destroyObj(faller);

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][MeteorImpact]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

restoreCaster();

cleanupAll();

}

`;

// ── Orchestration (GM) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: {

doneHook,

cfg: CFG,

assets: {

wf: wfUrl, meteor: METEOR_URL, explosion: EXPLOSION_URL,

cutin: CUTIN_SFX, jump: JUMP_SFX, charge: CHARGE_SFX, whoosh: WHOOSH_SFX, impact: IMPACT_SFX, land: LAND_SFX,

},

},

meta: { source: "Zero Power: Meteor Impact" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo reported non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

// Heal — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

const CFG = {"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"mode":"glacies","hue":200,"t":{"rel":1080,"total":2500},"sfx":[{"at":380,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Ice4.ogg","v":0.35},{"at":1080,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Ice1.ogg","v":0.315,"n":1},{"at":1240,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Ice1.ogg","v":0.315,"n":2},{"at":1400,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Ice1.ogg","v":0.315,"n":3}]};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"mc":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Ragnarok%20Online/efst_magiccircle__mc.webm","w":112,"h":64,"dur":2417,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5},"ice1":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/071_ice_one_1.webm","w":718,"h":718,"dur":1000,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"ro":false}},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.hina-glacies";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Glacies]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

"const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;",

"const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);",

"const nw = (v && v.videoWidth) || tex.width || 100, nh = (v && v.videoHeight) || tex.height || 100;",

"if (v) { try { v.loop = false; v.currentTime = 0; v.playbackRate = p.rate || 1; await v.play(); } catch (e) {} }",

"const dur = p.duration || ((v && isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration * 1000 / (p.rate || 1) : 1000));",

combatId: combat.id,

round: combat.round,

value: `${currentValue} -> ${nextValue}`,

lossNow,

remainingLoss

});

return {

ok: true,

consumed: true,

lossNow,

remainingLoss,

valueBefore: currentValue,

valueAfter: nextValue

};

}

async function applyStopToCombatant(combat, combatant, targetActor, tokenDoc) {

if (!combat || !combatant) {

return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat-or-combatant" };

}

const actionCardId = getActionCardId();

const existing = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY) ?? {};

const existingActionIds = Array.isArray(existing?.actionCardIds)

? existing.actionCardIds.map(String)

: [];

if (actionCardId && existingActionIds.includes(String(actionCardId))) {

console.log(TAG, "Stop already applied for this action card. Skipping duplicate.", {

target: combatant.name,

actionCardId

});

return {

ok: true,

skipped: true,

reason: "duplicate-action-card",

combatantId: combatant.id

};

}

if (

existing?.active &&

!ALLOW_STACKING_FROM_DIFFERENT_ACTIONS

) {

console.log(TAG, "Stop already pending on this target. Stacking disabled; skipping.", {

target: combatant.name,

existing

});

return {

ok: true,

skipped: true,

reason: "already-pending-stacking-disabled",

combatantId: combatant.id

};

}

const oldValue = readLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", 0);

// If the target still has an activation available, remove it immediately.

if (oldValue > 0) {

const nextValue = Math.max(0, oldValue - 1);

await setLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", nextValue);

const flagData = buildStopFlagData({

existing,

combat,

combatant,

targetActor,

tokenDoc,

pendingLoss: 0,

actionCardId,

active: false,

consumed: true

});

flagData.consumedRound = Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0;

flagData.consumedAt = Date.now();

flagData.immediate = true;

await combatant.setFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY, flagData);

emitTurnBarRefresh("stop-immediate");

console.log(TAG, "Stop HIT: removed 1 available activation immediately.", {

target: combatant.name,

round: combat.round,

value: `${oldValue} -> ${nextValue}`

});

return {

ok: true,

applied: true,

mode: "immediate",

combatantId: combatant.id,

valueBefore: oldValue,

valueAfter: nextValue

};

}

// Otherwise, store a pending loss for the next time they gain an activation.

const oldPending = existing?.active

? Math.max(0, Number(existing.pendingLoss ?? 1) || 1)

: 0;

const nextPending = oldPending + 1;

const flagData = buildStopFlagData({

existing,

combat,

combatant,

targetActor,

tokenDoc,

pendingLoss: nextPending,

actionCardId,

active: true,

consumed: false

});

await combatant.setFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY, flagData);

console.log(TAG, "Stop HIT: target has no available activation now, stored pending activation loss.", {

target: combatant.name,

round: combat.round,

oldPending,

nextPending

});

return {

ok: true,

applied: true,

mode: "pending",

combatantId: combatant.id,

pendingLoss: nextPending

};

}

async function applyAllPendingStops(combat, reason = "bulk-pending-check") {

if (!combat) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat" };

let checked = 0;

let consumed = 0;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data?.active) continue;

checked++;

const result = await tryConsumePendingStop(combat, combatant, reason);

if (result?.consumed) consumed++;

}

return { ok: true, checked, consumed };

}

async function cleanupOldStopLedgers(combat, reason = "cleanup") {

if (!combat) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat" };

let cleaned = 0;

const currentRound = Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data) continue;

if (data.active) continue;

const touchedRound = Number(data.lastTouchedRound ?? data.consumedRound ?? data.appliedRound ?? 0) || 0;

// Keep same-round ledger to dedupe duplicate clients.

// Clean it once the combat moves beyond that round.

if (currentRound > touchedRound) {

await combatant.unsetFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

cleaned++;

}

}

if (cleaned > 0) {

console.log(TAG, "Cleaned old Stop ledgers.", {

reason,

combatId: combat.id,

round: currentRound,

cleaned

});

}

return { ok: true, cleaned };

}

function installStopHooksOnce() {

const old = globalThis[GLOBAL_KEY];

if (old?.installed && old.version === VERSION) return old;

if (old?.hookIds?.length) {

for (const [hookName, hookId] of old.hookIds) {

try {

Hooks.off(hookName, hookId);

} catch (_) {}

}

}

const state = {

installed: true,

version: VERSION,

hookIds: []

};

const hUpdateCombat = Hooks.on("updateCombat", async (combat, changed) => {

if (!combat) return;

if (hasOwn(changed, "round")) {

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

await applyAllPendingStops(combat, "round-change");

await cleanupOldStopLedgers(combat, "round-change");

}

if (changed?.started === false || changed?.active === false) {

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data) continue;

try {

await combatant.unsetFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

} catch (_) {}

}

}

});

const hCombatRound = Hooks.on("combatRound", async (combat) => {

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

await applyAllPendingStops(combat, "combatRound-hook");

await cleanupOldStopLedgers(combat, "combatRound-hook");

});

const hFabulaRoundChanged = Hooks.on("oni.fabulaInitiative.roundChanged", async (event) => {

const combat =

game.combats?.get?.(event?.combatId) ??

game.combat ??

null;

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

await applyAllPendingStops(combat, "fabula-roundChanged");

await cleanupOldStopLedgers(combat, "fabula-roundChanged");

});

const hUpdateCombatant = Hooks.on("updateCombatant", async (combatant, changed) => {

if (!combatant) return;

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data?.active) return;

// When activations.value changes from a later reset/grant, try to consume pending Stop.

const changedFlags = changed?.flags?.[LI]?.activations ?? changed?.flags?.[LI] ?? null;

const mayHaveActivationChange =

!!changedFlags ||

JSON.stringify(changed ?? {}).includes("activations");

if (!mayHaveActivationChange) return;

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

const combat = getCombatForCombatant(combatant);

await tryConsumePendingStop(combat, combatant, "updateCombatant");

});

const hDeleteCombat = Hooks.on("deleteCombat", async (combat) => {

if (!combat) return;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data) continue;

try {

await combatant.unsetFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

} catch (_) {}

}

});

state.hookIds.push(

["updateCombat", hUpdateCombat],

["combatRound", hCombatRound],

["oni.fabulaInitiative.roundChanged", hFabulaRoundChanged],

["updateCombatant", hUpdateCombatant],

["deleteCombat", hDeleteCombat]

);

globalThis[GLOBAL_KEY] = state;

console.log(TAG, "Installed Stop activation hooks.");

return state;

}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Main execution

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

installStopHooksOnce();

const combat = game.combat ?? null;

if (!combat || !combat.started) {

console.warn(TAG, "No active started combat. Stop activation penalty skipped.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no-active-started-combat" };

}

const targetUuids = getTargetUuids();

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No saved targets found. Stop activation penalty skipped.");

return { ok: false, reason: "no-targets" };

}

const results = [];

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const { actor: targetActor, tokenDoc } = await resolveActorAndToken(targetUuid);

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor.", { targetUuid });

results.push({

targetUuid,

ok: false,

reason: "target-actor-not-found"

});

continue;

}

const hitInfo = isHitTarget(targetUuid, targetActor, tokenDoc);

console.log(TAG, "Stop hit check.", {

target: targetActor.name,

targetUuid,

hit: hitInfo.hit,

reason: hitInfo.reason,

accTotal: hitInfo.accTotal,

defenseUsed: hitInfo.defenseUsed,

hasAccuracy: hitInfo.hasAccuracy,

explicitForceMiss: hitInfo.explicitForceMiss,

explicitAutoHit: hitInfo.explicitAutoHit

});

if (!hitInfo.hit) {

results.push({

targetUuid,

targetName: targetActor.name,

ok: true,

skipped: true,

reason: "miss",

hitInfo

});

continue;

}

const combatant = findCombatantForActorOrToken(combat, targetActor, tokenDoc);

if (!combatant) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not find target combatant in current combat.", {

target: targetActor.name,

targetUuid,

actorUuid: targetActor.uuid,

tokenUuid: tokenDoc?.uuid ?? null

});

results.push({

targetUuid,

targetName: targetActor.name,

ok: false,

reason: "target-combatant-not-found"

});

continue;

}

const result = await applyStopToCombatant(combat, combatant, targetActor, tokenDoc);

results.push({

targetUuid,

targetName: targetActor.name,

hitInfo,

...result

});

}

const appliedCount = results.filter(r => r?.applied).length;

const missCount = results.filter(r => r?.reason === "miss").length;

console.log(TAG, "Stop resolution complete.", {

appliedCount,

missCount,

results

});

return {

ok: true,

appliedCount,

missCount,

results

};

}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Permission assurance / GM authority bridge

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const TAG = "[CL-RES][Stop][Authority]";

const MODULE_ID = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const PAYLOAD =

(typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD)

? __PAYLOAD

: (typeof payload !== "undefined" ? payload : null);

const ARGS =

(typeof __ARGS !== "undefined" && __ARGS)

? __ARGS

: (typeof args !== "undefined" && args ? args : {});

const TARGETS =

(typeof __TARGETS !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(__TARGETS))

? __TARGETS

: (typeof targets !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : []);

const CHAT_MSG =

(typeof __CHAT_MSG !== "undefined" && __CHAT_MSG)

? __CHAT_MSG

: null;

if (!PAYLOAD) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing payload before authority check.");

return { ok: false, reason: "missing-payload" };

}

PAYLOAD.meta = PAYLOAD.meta || {};

function mergeInPlace(target, source, { arrayKeys = [] } = {}) {

if (!source || typeof source !== "object") return target;

try {

foundry.utils.mergeObject(target, source, {

insertKeys: true,

insertValues: true,

overwrite: true,

recursive: true,

inplace: true

});

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "mergeObject failed; falling back to Object.assign.", e);

Object.assign(target, source);

}

for (const key of arrayKeys) {

if (Array.isArray(source?.[key])) {

target[key] = foundry.utils.deepClone(source[key]);

}

}

return target;

}

const attackerUuid =

PAYLOAD?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

PAYLOAD?.attackerActorUuid ??

PAYLOAD?.attackerUuid ??

ARGS?.attackerUuid ??

null;

if (!game.user?.isGM) {

const gmExecutor =

game.modules?.get(MODULE_ID)?.api?.GMExecutor ??

globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.GMExecutor ??

null;

if (!gmExecutor?.executeSnippet) {

const msg = "Stop requires GMExecutor when used by a player client, but GMExecutor is not available.";

console.warn(TAG, msg);

ui.notifications?.warn?.(msg);

if (ARGS) {

ARGS.__abortConfirm = true;

ARGS.__abortReason = msg;

}

PAYLOAD.meta.__abortResolution = true;

PAYLOAD.meta.__abortResolutionReason = msg;

return { ok: false, reason: "gm-executor-missing" };

}

console.log(TAG, "Non-GM client detected. Forwarding Stop activation mutation to GMExecutor.", {

user: game.user?.name,

attackerUuid,

targetsCount: TARGETS.length,

chatMsgId: CHAT_MSG?.id ?? null

});

const authorityScript = `

const context = env.makeContext("resolution");

const __runStopAuthorityCore__ = ${__runStopAuthorityCore__.toString()};

return await __runStopAuthorityCore__();

`.trim();

const remote = await gmExecutor.executeSnippet({

mode: "resolution",

scriptText: authorityScript,

payload: PAYLOAD,

args: ARGS,

targets: TARGETS,

chatMsgId: CHAT_MSG?.id ?? null,

actorUuid: attackerUuid,

metadata: {

origin: "Stop Custom Logic Resolution",

purpose: "reduce-target-next-activation",

permissionBridge: true

}

});

console.log(TAG, "GMExecutor returned.", {

ok: !!remote?.ok,

error: remote?.error ?? null,

hasPayload: !!remote?.payload,

hasArgs: !!remote?.args,

resultValue: remote?.resultValue ?? null

});

if (remote?.payload) {

mergeInPlace(PAYLOAD, remote.payload, {

arrayKeys: ["targets", "originalTargetUUIDs", "originalTargetActorUUIDs"]

});

}

if (remote?.args) {

mergeInPlace(ARGS, remote.args);

}

if (!remote?.ok) {

const msg = String(remote?.error ?? "Stop GM execution failed.");

console.warn(TAG, msg, remote);

if (ARGS) {

ARGS.__abortConfirm = true;

ARGS.__abortReason = msg;

}

PAYLOAD.meta.__abortResolution = true;

PAYLOAD.meta.__abortResolutionReason = msg;

return {

ok: false,

via: "gm-executor",

reason: "gm-executor-failed",

error: msg,

stack: String(remote?.stack ?? "")

};

}

return {

ok: true,

via: "gm-executor",

result: remote?.resultValue ?? null

};

}

// GM client / GMExecutor authority path.

return await __runStopAuthorityCore__();

props.animation_script:
// @desc Hina Lunar Bow attack: moon-dust gathers at the bow, a moonlight arrow flies, a crescent moon blooms on the hit (pixelfx, original)

"use strict";

// Lunar Bow (Hina's weapon, Light). Every visual here is original pixel-art code,

// written with the pixelfx method (E:\...\Animation\pixelfx\src\fx\fu\lunar-arrow.js

// and lunar-impact.js), exported as 3-layer clips and played with oni.pxfx.

//

// Beats: moon-dust gathers at the bow | loose: the arrow flies chest to chest |

// HIT: crescent impact + damage + hitstop | MISS: the arrow streaks past and fades.

//

// DAMAGE TIMING: animation_damage_timing_options = "default", so the damage gate is

// oni:animationEnd. The outer fires it when the inner calls oni.fireDone() at contact.

(async () => {

const PX = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/pixelfx/";

const CFG = {

S: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/",

arrow: { base: PX + "pxfx_light_lunar_arrow", width: 256, anchor: { x: 0.8125, y: 0.5 } },

impact: { base: PX + "pxfx_light_lunar_impact", width: 352, anchor: { x: 0.5, y: 0.875 } },

gatherMs: 320, // moon-dust drawn into the bow

flyMs: 380, // arrow flight, whatever the distance (reads as one quick shot)

arrowK: 1.0, // arrow size on top of its depth scale

impactK: 1.5, // the crescent reads small at board zoom at 1.0

impactSkipMs: 60, // the impact clip's own streak overlaps the arrow; start it here

hitstopMs: 70,

chest: 0.45, // aim point, as a fraction of the drawn body height from the feet

missPastPx: 260, // a miss carries on this far past the target, fading

volume: 0.8,

previewOutcome: "hit",

};

const P = payload ?? globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const casterUuid = P.casterTokenUuid ?? P.sourceTokenUuid ?? null;

const targetUuids = (P.targetTokenUuids ?? (P.targets ?? []).map((t) => t.tokenUuid) ?? []).filter(Boolean);

const doneHook = "oni:done:" + foundry.utils.randomID(8);

// Did it land? payload.outcomes (stamped after the accuracy roll), else the live director.

let outcome = null;

try {

const pick = (rows) => (Array.isArray(rows) && rows.length ? rows.find((r) => r && r.tokenUuid === targetUuids[0]) ?? rows[0] : null);

let row = pick(P.outcomes);

if (!row) row = pick(globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.()?.ctx?.actionResult?.perTargetResults);

if (row && row.hit !== null && row.hit !== undefined) outcome = row.hit ? "hit" : "miss";

} catch (e) { /* bench / no battle: previewOutcome */ }

const onceHook = (name, ms) => new Promise((resolve) => {

const id = Hooks.once(name, () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });

const t = setTimeout(() => { Hooks.off(name, id); resolve(); }, ms);

});

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { local: true, world: false });

// INNER (every client). No backticks and no dollar-brace inside.

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const outcome = ctx.params.outcome || cfg.previewOutcome || 'hit';

const caster = oni.caster;

const target = oni.targets[0] || null;

if (!caster || !target) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

// Where a body is DRAWN (3D stage aware): feet, chest, depth scale.

const drawn = (t) => {

const st = globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__;

const b = st && st.drawnMeshBounds ? st.drawnMeshBounds(t) : null;

if (b && Number.isFinite(b.x)) {

const W = canvas.stage.worldTransform;

const feet = W.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y + b.height));

const top = W.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(b.x + b.width / 2, b.y));

return { feet: feet, chest: { x: feet.x, y: feet.y + (top.y - feet.y) * cfg.chest }, m: b.width / Math.abs(t.mesh.width || b.width) };

}

return { feet: { x: t.center.x, y: t.y + t.h }, chest: { x: t.center.x, y: t.center.y }, m: 1 };

};

const A = drawn(caster), B = drawn(target);

const dir = (B.chest.x - A.chest.x) >= 0 ? 1 : -1, mirror = dir < 0;

const ang = Math.atan2(B.chest.y - A.chest.y, Math.abs(B.chest.x - A.chest.x)) * dir;

const bowX = A.chest.x + dir * 18 * A.m, bowY = A.chest.y;

// 1. Draw: moon-dust gathers into the bow.

oni.particles({ x: bowX, y: bowY, mode: 'gather', count: 18, color: 0xd8dcf4, size: 7, radius: 70 * A.m, life: cfg.gatherMs, stagger: 60, blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD });

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Starlight.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.25 });

await oni.wait(cfg.gatherMs);

// 2. Loose.

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Crossbow.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.45 });

const arrow = await oni.pxfx(cfg.arrow, { x: bowX, y: bowY, mirror: mirror, k: cfg.arrowK * A.m });

for (const f of arrow.parts) { f.video.loop = true; f.sprite.rotation = ang; }

const fly = (x0, y0, x1, y1, ms, fadeOut) => oni.tween({ duration: ms, ease: (u) => u * u * 0.35 + u * 0.65, onUpdate: (u) => {

const x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * u, y = y0 + (y1 - y0) * u;

for (const f of arrow.parts) { f.sprite.position.set(x, y); if (fadeOut) f.sprite.alpha = 1 - u; }

} });

const endArrow = () => { for (const f of arrow.parts) { try { f.video.loop = false; f.video.pause(); f.sprite.destroy(); } catch (e) {} } };

if (outcome === 'miss') {

// it passes just over the target and carries on, fading

const lift = -14 * B.m;

await fly(bowX, bowY, B.chest.x, B.chest.y + lift, cfg.flyMs, false);

oni.fireDone();

const slope = (B.chest.y - A.chest.y) / ((B.chest.x - A.chest.x) || 1);

const px = B.chest.x + dir * cfg.missPastPx * B.m, py = B.chest.y + lift + slope * (px - B.chest.x);

await fly(B.chest.x, B.chest.y + lift, px, py, cfg.flyMs * 0.7, true);

endArrow();

return;

}

await fly(bowX, bowY, B.chest.x, B.chest.y, cfg.flyMs, false);

endArrow();

// 3. Hit: the crescent blooms where it lands; damage on the flash.

const hit = await oni.pxfx(cfg.impact, { token: target, mirror: mirror, k: cfg.impactK });

try { for (const f of hit.parts) f.video.currentTime = cfg.impactSkipMs / 1000; } catch (e) {}

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Hit_Piercing.wav', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.45 });

oni.sfx(cfg.S + 'Soundboard/Starlight.ogg', { volume: cfg.volume * 0.35 });

oni.hit();

oni.fireDone();

await oni.hitstop(cfg.hitstopMs);

// the crescent and its dust outlive the script (oni.vfx clips are not disposed)

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "anim-studio/hina-lunar-bow",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: casterUuid,

targetTokenUuids: targetUuids,

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, outcome },

});

await onceHook(doneHook, CFG.gatherMs + CFG.flyMs + 6000);

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { local: true, world: false });

})();

When a rule or ability requires you to spend 100 or fewer Hit Points, Mind Points, or
Inventory Points, you may suffer 1d8 Instability Points to ignore that cost.

to you losing control of your abilities. Then, you lose all Instability Points
